metadata.title: 隣接する種類の変化回数から、二種類の個数を少ない質問で数える
metadata.summary: 少数を決定木で識別して既知の対象を増やし、その後は個々の種類を確定せず一括して数える。適応的な返答にも最悪226問を保証する。
aliases: Five-unknown decision trees and majority batches
隣接変化回数 同種既知 適応的grader 226問

reference.title: キノコを数えよう (Counting Mushrooms)
reference.evidence: 同種既知と未知を交互に並べると返答は端の逆種bit+内部の逆種数の2倍となり、個数と次の既知一個を同時に得られる。5未知の二つの識別木で多数派110まで訓練し、残りを多数派で一括計数する。全整合配置で不変な個数/既知を保ち、原典全域で226問・総長40306以下を保証する。
reference.verificationNotes: 2026-10-15に公式原典3ページ・公式解説2ページ・AOI国委員会の配布原典PDF/モデル解/manager/task設定を確認した。通常web抽出で欠ける原典数値は、GitHub read connectorのbase64 PDFを復号しpdftoppmで全3ページを描画してview_imageで実際に読んだ。N2..20000、列長2..N、番号0..N−1相異、総質問長100000、ハード20000問、満点Q<=226、各返答後の履歴整合性を確認し、配布managerの同じ規則・採点と照合した。2つの局所5未知決定木と多数派110切替は配布モデル解decision-tree-endagorion.cppを参照し、全32割当の葉一意性と基準反転を独立literal oracleで確認した。訓練t<=44/質問<=2t+1、後半容量max(110,ceil((1+5t+j)/2))、平方の床関数による整数和から最悪226問を独立に証明。総長17t+2(n−1−5t)<=40306、各列相異性/2..Nと全可変状態localも証明した。実MDX単一C++20 fenceを抽出して、macroあり原典adapterとmacro無し/stub無しcallbackの別実行ファイルを通常/ASan/UBSanで検証した。原典adapter側23642187検査・131304静的実行・局所128割当・適応5586状態/3814葉・訓練counts DP2611訪問状態・実現226問witness・936843質問・総列長10341444、checksum17036070644408443896、max実測総長40295。standalone側4099例・314871検査、checksum7379661480237581096。通常0.150602秒/4836KiB、ASan/UBSan1.97564秒/448900KiB（計測は原典adapter側、LeakSanitizerのみptrace環境のため無効）。原典全域と適応的最悪予算を確認済みで、主要補題未確認なし。公式解説の抽出で欠けた式を読めたとはせずverificationはindependent-analysis。初回auditのunconfirmed/数値falseは書換えず後続証拠として提出する。

problemFeature.title: キノコを数えよう (Counting Mushrooms)
features: A/Bの二種類があり、0番だけがAと既知。相異なる番号の列を質問すると、隣接する種類の変化回数が返る。
履歴と整合する配置を選び続ける適応的graderにも、Aの総数が全整合配置で共通と保証して返す。

modelSolution.author: Mikhail Tikhomirov
modelSolution.referencedContent: The two five-unknown query trees and majority cutoff110; no model globals/macros copied into the reusable API.

rulesVerified: adaptive answers must remain globally consistent

originalConstraints.adaptive: after every interaction at least one fixed species sequence is consistent with the whole transcript

subsequentSourceVerifications.notes: 全3ページの原典画像と配布managerで確認。初回auditのconstraints/reviewStatus/technicalFindingsは書換えず後続に追記する。

api.domain: n1..20000; species[0]=A; machine(vector<int>) returns adjacent species changes and is consistent with the entire transcript. Original n2..20000 fully included.
api.queryContract: Each sequence has length2..n, uses distinct0-based IDs, and refers only to actual unknown/known objects. Repeated same-type anchor symbols map to different physical IDs.
api.errors: invalid_argument for n outside1..20000 before callback. runtime_error for out-of-range reply or no surviving local assignment. Callback exceptions propagate. logic_error diagnoses an impossible internal query/budget invariant.
api.originalAdapter: Define TWO_SPECIES_IOI_GRADER to enable int count_mushrooms(int n) and the use_machine declaration for original-grader linking. Without the macro the complete visible fence links with a plain callback and no machine stub.
api.integerSafety: n/count/IDs<=20000; response<query length; bitmask candidates use uint32 shifts0..31. Query stats and stamps use size_t, checked before addition/callback. No unchecked signed narrowing outside these bounds.
api.time: O(n) excluding oracle work; local32-mask search and at most44 training rounds are bounded constants.
api.callIndependence: All mutable labels, known pools, stamps and counters are local. Rule arrays are immutable constexpr. No recursion or randomization.

proofInvariants: Each training group has exactly five new unknown IDs; local32 candidates contain every assignment consistent with its full local transcript. Each leaf is unique for both reference species.
Mixed tree uses at most3 distinct same-type and1 opposite anchor, at most2 queries and total length17. Single-anchor tree uses one anchor, at most3 queries and length16; all-zero mask needs1 query.
The only training round that can exceed2 queries is the first round revealing the opposite species. Hence t rounds cost at most2t+1.
After t rounds known T=1+5t. Majority reaches111 by t44. If fewer than5 remain, at most4 later queries suffice.
In bulk, r=d0+2*sum_{i>=1}di. Opposite count=ceil(r/2), endpoint type=reference XOR(r&1). Count the whole batch once and add the endpoint to known without recounting it.
After j bulk queries known total=T+j and majority is at leastmax(110,ceil((T+j)/2)). This lower bound holds for every adaptive transcript.
For q=225−2t,22<=t<=43: capacity−(20000−T)=floor((9t²−824t+19040)/4)>=62; for t44 margin52. Total queries<=226.
Each new unknown is processed once. Training total length<=17t; bulk length2(n−1−5t); total<=2n−2+7t<=40306.
Per-query distinctness follows from disjoint known and new IDs and distinct anchor slots. Bulk2k<=n because k<=known and k<=remaining.
Every count and added known endpoint is common to all currently consistent worlds, so adaptive grading cannot invalidate earlier inferences.

flowSuggestion.proposedAnswerLabel: 相異なる番号を並べると、隣り合う種類が変わる回数が返る

guards.feature: 二種類の対象があり、0番だけがAと既知で、Aの総数を数える。
相異なる番号の列を質問し、隣接する種類の変化回数が返る。適応的な返答も全履歴と整合する。
Nは2..20000、各質問長2..N。226問・総質問長100000以内でよい。掲載実装は最悪226問・総長40306以下。

verification.budgetStatesDefinition: reachable training-DP states visited in totals1,6,...,216; every reached terminal state (including total221) is separately checked against its worst bulk continuation.

standaloneCallback.domain: all anchor-A binary strings n1..12 plus four n20000 patterns and pre-callback invalid n

oracles.local: Both actual decision trees run against literal adjacent species comparisons for all32 masks and both reference complements, with minimal anchor counts. Every reachable query node is covered and returned five-bit assignment must equal the original mask.
oracles.static: Every anchored binary species string n1..17; all replies literally count unequal adjacent species; compare final answer to direct zero count and independently validate every query and counter.
oracles.adaptive: For each n2..12, keep all2^(n−1) fixed worlds consistent with the full transcript; branch over every possible literal response. At every leaf all surviving worlds must have exactly the returned A count.
oracles.budget: Dynamic program on counts(a,b), branching over every local five-bit assignment/cost. Check every terminal state with the worst water-filling bulk continuation. Materialize a consistent adaptive policy attaining226 calls, then replay the exact resulting fixed world. Also verify every integer-capacity certificate t22..44.
oracles.standalone: Entire visible fence compiled without IOI macro or external machine definition, linked and run with an ordinary literal callback.

cases: All128 local mask/complement/tree cases and every rule node.
All131071 anchored binary strings n1..17 plus boundary, large, random and policy witnesses.
Full adaptive response tree n2..12:5586 states3814 leaves, with query transcript replay and all-world count agreement.
Exact226-query consistent maximal-input adversary and replay as a fixed hidden world.
N20000 all-A, all-B except anchor, alternating, block patterns; training cutoff/tail dimensions;160 seeded random inputs including80 at maximum N.
All per-query lengths, ID range/distinctness, total length, strict226-call cap and returned statistics verified independently.
Invalid n0/negative/20001/INT_MIN/MAX before callback; negative/huge/impossible responses; callback exception propagation; n1 no callback.
Separate standalone no-macro/no-stub executable covers4099 cases and314871 checks in both normal and sanitizer modes.

independentReview.notes: 原典と全掲載実装を独立に精読し、通常とASan/UBSanを再実行して両者の件数・checksumを再現。Mushroomsでは原典用adapterの無条件リンク依存を検出し、macro有無の二つの実行ファイルで修正を確認した。

editorNotes: Eight sections with one always-visible complete C++20 fence. Source text is summarized, not reproduced; the finite query table is attributed to the official distributed model.
Only /tmp artifacts were edited; shared articles/data/initial audit remain unchanged. Initial unconfirmed/numeric-false record must be preserved and later evidence appended.
Original PDF/PNGs are retained temporarily at sourceVerification.nationalCommitteeOriginalPdf paths because root requested them for independent visual review.
Article is ready for independent review and flow integration; publication/flow/plan/resolution are root responsibilities.
Plants was deferred because its two-neighbor compression and cyclic reachability lemmas remain unresolved; Mushrooms local trees and worst budgets are now independently established.
